title: Add CLI

context.summary: Create the Mindory CLI command layer over the HTTP API.
context.background: TASK-11 added MCP tools over HTTP. TASK-12 adds a separate installable CLI app that follows the same HTTP source-of-truth rule.

in: Add a mindory CLI binary entrypoint in @mindory/cli.
Implement dependency-free argument parsing for bootstrap commands.
Implement an HTTP API client with JSON requests and multipart document upload.
Add commands for project, token, session, message, document, memory, context and jobs operations.
Add CLI API URL/token configuration to config, .env.example and Docker Compose.
Add CLI validation to repository checks.
Update CLI, API, configuration and README docs.
out: Install commander, yargs or other CLI dependencies.
Implement API endpoints that are still future tasks.
Add direct database, queue, vector or storage access from CLI.
Implement interactive prompts, shell completion or rich terminal UI.
Install dependencies if pnpm is unavailable in the local environment.

acceptance_criteria: CLI commands call the Mindory HTTP API rather than database or internal runtime services.
CLI includes project, token, session, message, document, memory, context and jobs command areas.
Document upload reads a local file and sends multipart form data.
Memory remember requires evidence source references through --source-ref.
Context build sends project ids, optional session id, query and token budget.
CLI config includes API URL and optional API token in config, .env.example and Docker Compose.
Documentation describes current CLI commands and bootstrap limitations.
No CLI dependency installation, direct persistence access or Hermes behavior is implemented.

commands: ls apps/cli/src/args.ts apps/cli/src/commands.ts apps/cli/src/http-client.ts apps/cli/src/run.ts scripts/validate-cli.js
manual_checks: Confirm CLI code calls HTTP paths and does not import @mindory/db or Drizzle.
Confirm no CLI dependency installation, interactive shell, completion or Hermes behavior was added.

risks: Local pnpm is unavailable in the current environment, so TypeScript execution may need to wait until dependencies are installed.
Several CLI commands target planned HTTP endpoints that are not implemented by the API skeleton yet.
The bootstrap CLI parser is intentionally minimal until a later task installs a CLI framework.
definition_of_done: Task status is changed to accepted or done.
Branch can be merged into master without unrelated changes.
